tool_schemas.name: models
tool_schemas.description: Lists indexed fal.ai models with optional filtering (keywords/status/tag/provider) and sorting, returning up to `limit` items and an opaque `cursor` to fetch the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, out-of-range `limit`, or malformed `cursor`, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the server is not permitted to query the provider. Raises RATE_LIMITED when model listing exceeds allowed request quotas.

keywords.description: Optional keywords to filter models by model_id, display_name, description, or tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Searches the indexed fal.ai model catalog by required `keywords`, returning up to `limit` matching models and an opaque `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `keywords` is missing/empty, `limit` is out of range, or `cursor` is malformed. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when access to the provider catalog is not permitted, and RATE_LIMITED when search exceeds allowed request quotas.

keywords.description: The search terms to find models.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching models to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: schema
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the OpenAPI schema for `model_id`, optionally forcing a refresh from fal.ai when `refresh` is true, and returns the schema document used to validate inputs for that model. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/malformed `model_id`, NOT_FOUND when the model does not exist (or is not visible to this server), and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the provider rejects schema access. Raises RATE_LIMITED when schema fetches exceed quota or provider limits.

refresh.description: Whether to force re-fetching the schema from fal.ai instead of using a cached copy.

tool_schemas.name: generate
tool_schemas.description: Submits a generation request to the specified `model` with the provided `input`; in `sync` mode it returns the completed generation result, and in `queued` mode it returns queue metadata including `status_url`, `response_url`, and `cancel_url` for lifecycle tracking. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `model` is missing/invalid, `mode` is invalid, or `input` does not conform to the model’s schema, NOT_FOUND when the model is unknown/unavailable, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller is not allowed to run the model. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request volume exceeds quotas, and CONFLICT when the model is disabled/deprecated for execution or otherwise refuses the requested run state.

model.description: The fal.ai model identifier slug to run (e.g., "fal-ai/flux/dev").

input.description: Model-specific input JSON payload (must conform to the model OpenAPI schema).

mode.description: Execution mode: return immediately (sync) or create a queued request (queued).

tool_schemas.name: result
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the final output for a queued generation using the provided `url` (the `response_url`), returning the generation result once available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing or not a valid queued response URL, NOT_FOUND when the referenced request cannot be resolved, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the request belongs to a different principal or is not accessible. Raises CONFLICT when the request is not yet complete (use the status endpoint) or has been cancelled/expired such that no result can be returned.

url.description: The response_url returned from a queued generation request.

tool_schemas.name: status
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the current lifecycle state for a queued generation using the provided `url` (the `status_url`), returning status details that indicate whether it is pending, running, completed, failed, or cancelled. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing or not a valid queued status URL, NOT_FOUND when the referenced request cannot be resolved, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the request is not accessible to the caller. Raises RATE_LIMITED when polling exceeds allowed quotas.

url.description: The status_url returned from a queued generation request.

tool_schemas.name: cancel
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to cancel a queued generation using the provided `url` (the `cancel_url`) and returns the cancellation outcome and any updated state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `url` is missing or not a valid cancel URL, NOT_FOUND when the referenced request cannot be resolved, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller cannot cancel that request. Raises CONFLICT when the request is already completed, already cancelled, or in a non-cancellable terminal state.

url.description: The cancel_url returned from a queued generation request.

tool_schemas.name: upload
tool_schemas.description: Uploads the file at `path` to fal.ai-backed storage and returns metadata including a stable `file_url` suitable for use in subsequent model inputs. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `path` is missing/invalid, the file cannot be read, or `content_type`/`filename` are invalid, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the caller is not permitted to upload to storage. Raises RATE_LIMITED when upload frequency or size exceeds allowed quotas, and CONFLICT when the upload is refused due to policy constraints (e.g., unsupported content type) for the target storage.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to the file to upload.

content_type.description: Optional MIME content type to associate with the uploaded file.

filename.description: Optional original filename to record for the upload.

tool_schemas.name: generation_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists generation requests for the authenticated API key with optional filtering (status/model/mode/time range) and cursor pagination. Returns up to `limit` items and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, out-of-range `limit`, malformed `cursor`, or invalid time range filters, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key/project is not active, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

status.description: Filter by generation request lifecycle status.

created_after.description: Include only requests created at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

created_before.description: Include only requests created at or before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of generation requests to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: generation_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single generation request by its internal `id`, returning the stored input, lifecycle status, upstream URLs (if queued), and any captured result/error payloads. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed `id`, NOT_FOUND when no such request exists, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the request belongs to a different principal or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: uploads
tool_schemas.description: Lists uploads for the authenticated API key with optional filtering (status/content_type) and cursor pagination. Returns up to `limit` items and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid enum values, out-of-range `limit`, or malformed `cursor`, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR when the API key/project is not active, and RATE_LIMITED when request quota is exceeded.

content_type.description: Filter by MIME content type (exact match).

limit.description: Maximum number of uploads to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.
